messages.author: a814dd0eade31e3e
messages.subject: Re: Is there any better way to stop a Shiny app besides Ctrl+C
parts:
To stop the app from within Shiny I initially used the following based on Joe Cheng's post at https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/close$20r/shiny-discuss/JptpzKxLuvU/boGBwwI3SjIJ

session$onSessionEnded(function() { q("no") })

This stops R when the user closes the browser window. However it also stops on browser refresh which can be a problem.

Now I use the following observer linked to an action button (as Jeff also suggests). This shuts down R but it leaves the browser window open.

observe({
  if(is.null(input$quitApp) || input$quitApp == 0) return()
  stopApp()
  q("no")
})

messages.subject: Re: Is there any better way to stop a Shiny app besides Ctrl+C
parts:
stopApp() stop the app and give the promp back in the R console when closing the browser.
No extra button required in the ui.R

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
    ...
    ...
    session$onSessionEnded(function() { stopApp() })
    }
)
